DDInter98.mechanism: Systemically or even topically administered miconazole may increase the plasma concentrations and hypoprothrombinemic effect of warfarin. The proposed mechanism is miconazole inhibition of CYP450 2C9, the isoenzyme responsible for the metabolic clearance of the more active S(-) enantiomer of warfarin.
